verdict.rationale: The only bulk-style evidence is the Marketing API's account export, which generates an export of account data in one operation. Sending a campaign to a whole audience is the product's core function, not a general bulk-operations capability. The pack never documents batch endpoints for bulk create, update, delete or tag operations across many contacts or items. Missing for 10: documented batch/bulk API operations for writes across many items, AI- or agent-driven bulk workflows, limits and error-handling for bulk jobs, independent or hands-on corroboration.
